arxiv-1907-08347.title: Fast nonthermal processes in pulsed laser deposition
arxiv-1907-08347.creator: Jeffrey G. Ulbrandt, Xiaozhi Zhang, Rui Liu, Kenneth Evans-Lutterodt, Matthew Dawber, Randall L. Headrick
arxiv-1907-08347.description: Abstract Pulsed Laser Deposition (PLD) is widely used to grow epitaxial thin films of quantum materials such as complex oxides. Here, we use in-situ X-ray scattering to study homoepitaxy of SrTiO 3 by energetic (e-) and thermalized (th-) PLD. We find that e-PLD suppresses the lateral growth of two-dimensional islands, which suggests that energetic particles break up smaller islands.

arxiv-2402-01046.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by *. State-of-the-art algorithms in lattice gauge theory typically rely heavily on detailed balance, which is an instrumental tool to prove the correct convergence of the Markov Chain Monte Carlo Algorithm. In this work, we investigate an alternative to detailed balance, skewed detailed balance, and the prospects of alleviating the topological freezing problem by studying the one-dimensional O ⁡ ( 2 ) O\left(2\right) model.

arxiv-2403-09278.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by . Non-periodic folding of periodic crease patterns paves the way to novel nonlinear phenomena that cannot be feasible through periodic folding. This paper focuses on the non-periodic folding of recursive crease patterns generalized from Spidron. Although it is known that Spidron has a 1 1 -DOF isotropic rigid folding motion, its general kinematics and dependence on the crease pattern remain unclear.

arxiv-2501-11041.title: Enhancing Semantic Consistency of Large Language Models through Model Editing: An Interpretability-Oriented Approach
arxiv-2501-11041.creator: Jingyuan Yang, Dapeng Chen, Yajing Sun, Rongjun Li, Zhiyong Feng, Wei Peng
arxiv-2501-11041.description: Abstract A Large Language Model (LLM) tends to generate inconsistent and sometimes contradictory outputs when presented with a prompt that has equivalent semantics but is expressed differently from the original prompt. To achieve semantic consistency of an LLM, one of the key approaches is to finetune the model with prompt-output pairs with semantically equivalent meanings.

arxiv-2510-01958.description: Abstract Recent advances in speech enhancement have shown that models combining Mamba and attention mechanisms yield superior cross-corpus generalization performance. arxiv-2601-22329.title: Sparks of Rationality: Do Reasoning LLMs Align with Human Judgment and Choice?
arxiv-2601-22329.creator: Ala N. Tak, Amin Banayeeanzade, Anahita Bolourani, Fatemeh Bahrani, Ashutosh Chaubey, Sai Praneeth Karimireddy, Norbert Schwarz, Jonathan Gratch
arxiv-2601-22329.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly positioned as decision engines for hiring, healthcare, and economic judgment, yet real-world human judgment reflects a balance between rational deliberation and emotion-driven bias. If LLMs are to participate in high-stakes decisions or serve as models of human behavior, it is critical to assess whether they exhibit analogous patterns of (ir)rationalities and biases.

pmc-11650496.description: Background:Bereavement support is considered a core standard of care for paediatric palliative care (PPC) teams. Support for grieving siblings can present unique challenges.
